verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents its own framework integrations. Each one gives an agent a persistent browser with `run`, `snapshot` and `screenshot` tools. Integration pages exist for CrewAI (v4 docs and a v3 StagehandTool), Deep Agents, and Claude Code over MCP/stdio. Missing for 10: any documented Vercel AI SDK adapter, an explicit LangChain or Claude Agent SDK adapter (beyond Deep Agents and the Claude Code MCP integration), and independent hands-on corroboration of the adapters.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the browser layer into agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI) through documented adapters

citations.quote: Each integration gives your agent one persistent browser and three tools: `run`, `snapshot`, and `screenshot`.
Give a Claude Code agent persistent Stagehand browser tools over MCP/stdio.
The Deep Agents integration provides two deployment patterns with the same `run`, `snapshot`, and `screenshot` tools.
The StagehandTool wraps the Stagehand Python SDK to provide CrewAI agents with the ability to control a real web browser
